description: A Codex approval for an item whose earlier approval already settled gets its own occurrence id, so the channel's dedupe by native request id never hands it the earlier card's answer; a replay of a still-open card keeps its id (unit test: cli/test/codex-app-server.test.ts, 'an approval asked again for the same item never inherits the earlier answer'). The guard fails if the occurrence id or the settle bookkeeping is removed.
